Shri Sajid Iqbal Ansari - Advocate for the respondent  No.2/complainant.
ORDER 1] Heard finally with the consent of the parties.

2] This petition has been filed by the petitioner under Section 482 of Cr.P.C./Section 528 of Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023 for quashment of FIR bearing Crime No.412/2023 for the offence punishable under Sections 420, 467,
468, 471 of IPC, registered at Police Station Hatpipaliya, District Dewas, and all other consequential proceedings arising out of the said crime number.
3] Counsel for the petitioner, at the outset, has submitted that the parties have settled their disputes out of the Court.
No objection certificate along with compromise has also been filed on record.
It is also submitted that no purpose would be served to keep the matter pending when the matter is already compromised, and in such circumstances, the petition may be allowed.

4] Counsel for the respondent No.2 has submitted that he has no objection if NEUTRAL CITATION NO.
2025:MPHC-IND:29372 2 MCRC-43165-2025 the FIR is quashed.
5] Counsel for the respondent/State has submitted that appropriate order may be passed.
6] Having considered rival submissions, perusal of the documents filed on record, this Court has no hesitation to allow the present petition.
